title: Backup & Restore
description: Back up your complete user data and restore it into another SQLite instance.

empty.description: Create your first backup to secure your data

createDialog.title: Create Backup
createDialog.description: Create a portable backup of your data, including attachments and settings.

uploadDialog.title: Upload and Restore Backup
uploadDialog.description: Import your user data from a portable SQLite backup (.ofbak).
uploadDialog.warning: This replaces your current user data. A safety backup will be created automatically.

restoreDialog.title: Restore Backup?
restoreDialog.description: Replace your user data with the backup from {{date}}. A safety backup will be created automatically.

alerts.invalidFileType: Invalid file type. Please select a .ofbak file.
alerts.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 100 MB.
alerts.restoreRefreshFailed: Your data was restored, but preferences could not be refreshed. Sign out and sign back in to reload them.
alerts.restoreFailed: Restore failed. Check the backup file and the master password used when it was created.
alerts.downloadFailed: This backup cannot be downloaded. Create a new portable user backup; legacy whole-instance files are not supported.

overview.cardDescription: Create and manage backups of your financial data. Backups are compressed and include integrity verification for secure restoration.
overview.tipText: Automatic backups are created weekly by default. You can manually create backups at any time and restore from previous versions.
overview.aboutGzip: Backups are compressed (GZIP) to save disk space
overview.aboutChecksum: Each backup includes SHA-256 checksum for integrity verification
overview.aboutSafety: A safety backup is automatically created before restoring
overview.aboutRetention: Automatic backups are retained for the last 7 versions by default
overview.aboutDownload: You can download backups to store them externally

masterPassword.label: Backup master password (if encrypted)
masterPassword.help: Enter the master password used when this backup was created. Your destination account keeps its current login and master password.
